documentation.content: A post tripped an explicit-crisis phrase but admins could not be paged: either the FCM send failed, no crisis recipients are configured (system/crisisAlertRecipients), or recipients have no FCM token in users/{uid}/private/data. A self-harm post may be sitting un-triaged. Verify crisis recipient config and check the admin crisis tab. Source: onPostCreatedAlertAdmins in functions/index.js.

conditions.displayName: crisis-alert failure or misconfiguration log entry

conditionMatchedLog.filter: textPayload =~ "crisis-alert: (failed to alert admins|tripped explicit-crisis but no)"
